content:
Successful HWPX document automation requires handling fragmented text placeholders and stripping layout cache elements to prevent rendering artifacts.
Placeholders like {{name}} were often split across multiple <hp:t> elements, requiring reconstruction of paragraph text for replacement. Modifying text without removing <hp:lineSegArray> elements caused overlapping text, necessitating their removal from modified <hp:p> tags. Age calculation and phone normalization via regex were successfully integrated into the XML transformation pipeline.
